job.description: Test N12: is the noisy head held back by its readout? Four arms (clean, n80, n80-mix, sub20) on 5 new seeds (4101-4105), 20 training runs, plus 10 frozen fits of head B's readout, measured on the held-out tail's windows 1-512. Amendment A1 (fit convergence) approved. NEEDS AN A100: before Run all, choose Runtime > Change runtime type > A100 GPU. On any other GPU it stops before training. About 70 minutes. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
